title: Chandrayaan-3 Landing
description: 25s procedural ISRO Vikram descent, soft touchdown with leg compression, ramp unfolding & Pragyan rover rollout leaving wheel tracks near the lunar south pole.

title: SpaceX Starship Launch
description: Mirror-polished stainless steel Starship & Super Heavy launch simulation with procedural launch tower, ignition plume, and camera choreography.

title: SpaceX Starship Belly-Flop Landing
description: Starship atmospheric belly-flop descent through clouds, aerodynamic flip maneuver, and Raptor propulsive vertical landing.

title: Mysore Palace — Dasara Night
description: Procedural Indo-Saracenic architecture illuminated with thousands of warm Dasara festival lights against a night sky.

title: Grandmaster's Study — 3D Chess
description: Photorealistic procedural Staunton chess set, inlaid wooden board, and warm candlelit study atmosphere.

title: F1 Four-Car Grand Prix
description: Four procedural Formula 1 cars racing on a banked circuit with dynamic overtaking, wheel spin, and broadcast camera tracking.

title: Red & Black Hypercar
description: Procedural studio hypercar showcase with calibrated metallic paint, carbon-fiber details, opening doors, and studio softbox reflections.

title: Pagoda Bridge Gate
description: Multi-tiered East Asian pagoda, arched wooden bridge, torii gate, lantern glow, and reflective water pond.

title: Tropical Coast City
description: Procedural coastal skyline, animated ocean waves, shoreline cliffs, palm trees, and sunlit tropical atmosphere.

title: Snowy Log Cabin Diorama
description: Cozy winter timber cabin diorama with falling snow, glowing hearth windows, pine trees, and chimney smoke.

title: Supermassive Black Hole
description: Relativistic accretion disk, gravitational lensing halo, and deep-space starfield rendered with custom GLSL shaders.

title: Coffee Ghost
description: Stylized procedural 3D character scene with warm cafe lighting, rising steam, and playful animation.

title: Sci-Fi Galaxy Hologram
description: Spiral galaxy holographic projection with volumetric particle arms, scanlines, and futuristic emitter pedestal.

title: macOS Sequoia — Interactive Desktop
description: 3,500-line zero-CDN macOS Sequoia desktop OS clone built one-shot with Gemini 4 Neon: 3 animated mesh wallpapers, draggable/resizable window manager, Spotlight (Cmd/Ctrl+K), Calculator, Terminal (neofetch), Paint Studio, Web Audio Synth Player, and localStorage Notes.

title: Jensen Huang: The 11-Day Comeback
description: Playable neon retro arcade game built one-shot with Gemini 4 Neon: dodge -40% red stock candles & Board FUD, grab +30% NVDA rockets, Rubin GPUs, 180K Petition shockwaves, and Leather Jacket Invincibility to reclaim the CEO throne.

title: The Taj Mahal Testnet — Physics & Simulation Stress Tests
description: Single-file procedural semiconductor cleanroom simulation featuring a glowing gold Taj Mahal & PCB circuitry etched onto a thin-film iridescent silicon wafer, 3 IK robotic micro-probe arms, sweeping violet scan laser, live holographic consensus terminal, 16-node 3D validator network, 0-100% stress ramp (white-hot traces, FLIR thermal heatmap, EMI ripples, nanoscale FinFET zoom), live fault injection with self-healing trace rerouting, and procedural Web Audio soundscape.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold — Interactive 3D Unboxing
description: Single-file interactive 3D Samsung Galaxy Z TriFold unboxing with procedural Three.js geometry, Canvas textures, and Web Audio: lift the box lid, pull out the phone, peel the protective film, inspect the 200MP cameras, unfold both titanium hinges to 10.0", and unlock live 3-panel One UI.
